name: In The Groove

evidence.note: Band site calls its show 70s dance music and lists dance hits from the 70s to today.
Black Pearl show listing tells guests to bring their boogie shoes and get ready to groove.
Band's event page shows regular gigs at Black Pearl (Danford's, Port Jefferson) and Tiki Joe's.

dancing.notes: A disco and funk band built around dance music. Its shows are promoted as nights to bring your 'boogie shoes'.

description: A Long Island dance band that recreates 1970s disco and funk (Earth, Wind & Fire, Donna Summer) plus later dance hits.
genres: dance hits from the 70s to today
reviewNotes:
Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). Rated dance-band because the band markets itself around dance music; no evidence of partner or hustle dancing. Crowd video not watched.

Directory research 2026-10-04: All current links still correct and linked from the band's site. The site lists two booking contacts by first name: Andrew (631) 774-2373 and Tony (631) 848-0285; recorded the first as the band phone. No standalone logo on the site (the logo appears only inside a promo graphic; the apple-touch icon is a 'Find us on Facebook' badge). The YouTube video linked from the site is on a member's personal channel (@AndrewGJustGroovin), so no band YouTube recorded. Skipped two Meet-the-Band photos watermarked 'Corsetti Creative'. Current description is accurate; not replaced.

evidence.note: Band site: 70s dance music show recreating Earth, Wind & Fire, Brothers Johnson, Donna Summer, Teena Marie, Barry White, plus dance hits from the 70s to today; lists email, two contact phone numbers, Facebook and Instagram.
Schedule lists Sat Oct 4 at Black Pearl @ Danfords Marina, Port Jefferson, 3-8 PM (matches our listing), plus Oakdale Yacht Club, The Warehouse Amityville and Ristegios Patchogue.
Meet the Band page shows a large lineup: several lead singers, sax, trumpet, bass, drums, keyboards and guitar.
